analysis.title: PTS Technical Views: Currencies, Commodities & 10Y Yield
key_insights: Cross-asset technical signals turned more directional: DXY broke above 102.86, while EUR/USD, GBP/USD and AUD/USD weakened. Firmer US yields, a stronger USD and weaker commodities indicate renewed tightening pressure.

DXY is at 103.50, extending its recovery from the 95.55 low. The next hurdle is the 61.8% retracement at 104.59. A sustained monthly close above 104.59 would bring 110 into focus. A break below 102.86 would weaken the short-term setup, with support at 101.80-101.28. A bearish RSI divergence is emerging on the daily chart.

EUR/USD is at 1.1006. The short-term Wave 4 scenario is invalidated and lower highs keep the bias negative. Below 1.1131-1.1156, downside extends to 1.0906, then 1.0628. A sustained recovery above 1.1325 is needed to ease pressure. Monthly chart shows a rounding top below 1.20, with key long-term resistance at 1.2020.

GBP/USD is at 1.3186 and testing range support at 1.3137, with 1.3097 next. A decisive break below 1.3097 brings the Wave C scenario toward 1.2916 into focus. The pair has fallen below its 50- and 200-day SMAs. Monthly momentum is fading after repeated failures near 1.3771.

USD/JPY is at 159.58, recovering above its 50- and 200-day SMAs. The key hurdle is 161.35-161.95, and a break above it would bring the Wave 5 scenario toward 171.59 back into focus. Failure at the 158-159 area on the weekly chart could expose 153.06, then 149.40.
USD/CHF is at 0.8392 and capped below 0.8401 (50% Fibonacci retracement). A sustained break above 0.8401 points to 0.8588. A break below 0.8305 would refocus attention on 0.8176-0.8120.

AUD/USD is at 0.6750 after confirming a double-top breakdown below 0.6956, with focus on 0.6596. A recovery above 0.6956 would question the breakdown, and a move above the 200-day SMA near 0.7050 is needed to improve the medium-term outlook.

USD/CAD is at 1.4306 in an Elliott Wave uptrend, with wave 5 of (5) possibly under way and a potential extension toward 1.50. Short-term it is approaching resistance at 1.4300-1.4335 with bearish RSI divergence. A move below 1.4239 would be the first sign of weakness.

EUR/CHF is at 0.9236, with 0.9208 pivotal support. A sustained break below it would confirm a descending-triangle breakdown, bringing 0.8848 and then 0.8488 into focus. Short-term rebound faces a resistance cluster at 0.9238-0.9308.
EUR/GBP's downtrend is intact, with 0.8322 the next support, then 0.8222. Recovery above 0.8375 could lead to a rebound toward 0.8451-0.8469.

USD/CNH may be stabilising near 6.65, but the trend stays bearish below 6.74 and both SMAs. Potential bullish RSI divergence suggests fading downside momentum. Targets are 6.57 and 6.44, and a daily close above 6.74 would bring a rebound toward 6.84 and 6.90.

WTI crude is at 85.72, below its 200-day SMA after a lower low following a stall near 105. Next supports are 82.21 and 76.41. Reclaiming the 200-day SMA and the broken trendline would invalidate the bearish signal.

Gold is at 3,853, below the broken 3,878-3,944 support zone, with the bias negative. Potential bullish RSI divergence suggests fading downside momentum. Recovery above 3,944 then 4,055 is needed to confirm stabilisation. Supports are 3,500 and 3,339. All-time high is 5,595.
Silver is at 46.79 and holding above support at 45.53 (76.4% retracement), with RSI rebounding from oversold levels. Former supports at 49.77 and 54.78 now act as resistance.

Copper is at 6.01 after a sharp break below the 200-day SMA near 6.24. It is testing 5.82-6.00 support, and a sustained break below 5.82 points to 5.47, then 5.13. A recovery above 6.24 is needed to stabilise.

The US 10-year yield is at 5.13 after the retest of the 4.81% breakout area held. A sustained break above 5.367% would confirm upside momentum toward the 5.77% range-breakout objective. A move below 4.81% would weaken the setup, with 4.66-4.56% next support.

The US 5-year yield is testing the 4.90-4.99% resistance zone, and a break above 4.99% would bring 5.16% into focus. The US 2-year yield is rebounding from 4.47%, with 4.84-4.95% resistance, and a break below 4.32% would weaken the bullish Elliott Wave scenario.

The US 10Y-2Y spread rebounded from 0.23% to test the 0.52-0.55% resistance zone and pulled back. A sustained weekly break above it would signal renewed steepening toward 0.73%, with a longer-term projection near 0.995%.

The Germany 10-year yield is at 3.39%, pulling back from the 3.66% wave-3 target toward 3.27%. The 3.03-3.10% zone is key support, and a rebound above 3.66% would reactivate the 4.21% target. The Japan 10-year yield rebounded from the 200-day SMA at 2.64%, with the 50-day SMA near 2.92% the next hurdle and 3.28% beyond.

A US 10-year yield break above 5.367% would bring further tightening pressure across markets.

Gold and USD/CNH show potential bullish RSI divergence, suggesting fading downside momentum. Copper's RSI is falling toward oversold territory, which leaves scope for a tactical rebound.
